name: Meticulous Madness
source:
YOU AWAKENED, BUT YOU AREN'T ABLE TO MOVE.

You want to scream.
You are hushed before you can speak.
A petite woman with eyes so undoubtedly not meant for her face.
Memories flash, a woman in the freezing rain, with a smile so wide it bordered on manic in nature.
This is a laboratory, where you are to be the test cattle for genetic reconstruction. 

A meticulous kind of madness.

[From [url=https://equinox-86.itch.io/meticulous-madness]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你苏醒了过来，身体却动弹不得。

你想要尖叫。
可还没等你发出声音，就被人嘘声制止。
眼前是一个身材娇小的女人，脸上却长着一双无论如何都不该属于那张脸的眼睛。
记忆碎片骤然闪过——冰冷刺骨的大雨中，一个女人咧嘴笑着，夸张的弧度近乎癫狂。
这里是一座实验室，而你将沦为基因重构实验的活体牲畜。

一场精雕细琢的疯狂。

[摘自[url=https://equinox-86.itch.io/meticulous-madness]itch.io[/url]]
